unit.why: A short pre-Hasidic legend about the birth of R. Avraham de Pisa, promised by four sages to his grandfather for hosting the exiles from Spain. It is followed by a moral lesson on the reward for acts of kindness.
unit.boundary_note: The trailing words 'מענין גן עדן' are the heading of the next section, not part of this story.

stories.start_quote: הגאון כמוה״ר אברהם דפיסה זל"ה בא לעולם
stories.end_quote: מרבים שכר אביהם בעוה״ב. (מ״ת ענף גמח)
stories.summary_en: During the Spanish expulsion, R. Avraham de Pisa's grandfather lavishly supported fleeing Jews. Four visiting sages promised him a wise son within a year, to be named Avraham, and the promise came true; the author then draws a lesson on the reward for acts of kindness.

tags.why: Praises a pre-Hasidic Italian sage; cited from an earlier book (מ״ת).

quotes: א״ה ראה כח ג״ח כמה הוא
tags.why: Explicitly framed as a lesson on gemilut hasadim, under the heading 'מענין גמילות חסדים'.
The story is about the promised birth of a great sage.

quotes: ויצא ממנו בנו זה הג׳ והיה חכם
tags.why: The birth of the promised son is narrated.

quotes: מקבל עניים ועשירים ומכלכלם ומלוה אותם
tags.why: The grandfather supports the exiles at great expense.

quotes: בטח בה׳ שיצא תוך שנה בן מחלציך
tags.why: The sages predict the son's birth, and it comes true.
The narrative arc is a promise that is fulfilled.
The child is born through the sages' prayer and blessing, but childlessness is not stated.

quotes: שבהיות גלות ספרד היה בורחים משם היהודים
tags.why: The expulsion from Spain is the setting.

quotes: שמלבד השכר שיש לעושיה בעוה״ב יש לו שכר בעוה״ז
tags.why: The narrative is wrapped in a homiletic frame about reward.
The lesson discusses reward in the world to come.
